intent.goal: A small USB-C powered I2C sensor reader board that reads a BMP280 (pressure + temperature) on demand via a tact switch and flashes a status LED on a successful read, driven by a CH32V003 RISC-V MCU.
constraints: 5V input from USB-C, regulated down to 3V3 by a low-Iq LDO feeding both MCU and sensor
No battery and no charging circuitry
assumptions: BMP280 to be auto-fetched from LCSC and vendored into the parts library (defaulted)
BMP280 I2C address strap (SDO) left at part default (defaulted)
Status LED color: green (defaulted)
USB-C used for power only; no USB data or CC PD negotiation beyond 5V VBUS default (defaulted)
Final KiCad output synthesized into ./generated (defaulted)

blocks.name: USB_INPUT
blocks.purpose: Accepts 5V VBUS from a USB-C connector and provides input protection/decoupling for the downstream regulator.

blocks.name: LDO_3V3
blocks.purpose: Regulates the 5V USB input down to a 3V3 rail using a low-Iq SOT-23-5 LDO feeding the MCU and sensor.

blocks.name: MCU
blocks.purpose: CH32V003 RISC-V microcontroller that orchestrates the read sequence, talks I2C to the sensor, drives the LED, reads the switch, and exposes SWD/SWIO programming.

blocks.name: SENSOR
blocks.purpose: BMP280 pressure and temperature sensor that returns measurements to the MCU over I2C.

blocks.name: USER_IO
blocks.purpose: Tact switch that triggers a reading and a status LED that flashes on a successful read.

connections.description: 5V VBUS from USB-C to the LDO input.
Shared ground reference from USB-C to the regulator section.
I2C bus (SCL/SDA) between MCU and BMP280.
Tact switch line into an MCU GPIO to trigger a reading.
MCU GPIO drives the status LED on a successful read.

assumptions: I2C pull-ups reside in the SENSOR block adjacent to the BMP280 (defaulted)
Status LED is driven directly from an MCU GPIO with a series current-limit resistor (defaulted)
Tact switch uses the MCU internal pull-up so no external pull resistor is required (defaulted)
SWD/SWIO programming shares the single-wire interface on an MCU GPIO with no dedicated programming-header block (defaulted)
USB-C CC pins terminated to 5.1k pulldowns within the USB_INPUT block; power-only, no data (defaulted)

topologies.USB_INPUT: USB-C receptacle power-only with 5.1k CC pulldowns and VBUS bulk/decoupling
topologies.LDO_3V3: Low-Iq SOT-23-5 linear LDO, 5V to 3V3, with input/output ceramic caps
topologies.MCU: CH32V003J4M6 SOP-8 with VDD decoupling, internal-pullup switch input, GPIO LED drive, local single-wire SWIO
topologies.SENSOR: BMP280 I2C slave with local SDA/SCL pull-ups and supply decoupling
topologies.USER_IO: Tact switch to GND (MCU internal pull-up) plus GPIO-driven status LED with series resistor

history.content: Captured intent: small USB-C powered CH32V003 board reading a BMP280 over I2C with one tact switch and a status LED; 5V to 3V3 via low-Iq SOT-23-5 LDO, no battery; 0402 passives, single-sided, ~30x20mm, JLCPCB economy assembly. BMP280 to be auto-fetched from LCSC. Recorded cosmetic defaults as assumptions; no blocking questions.

Decomposed the board into 5 functional blocks: USB_INPUT (USB-C 5V interface + protection), LDO_3V3 (5V->3V3 low-Iq SOT-23-5 regulation), MCU (CH32V003 RISC-V processing exposing SWD/SWIO), SENSOR (BMP280 I2C sense), and USER_IO (tact switch trigger + status LED). Connections cover the 5V/ground feed into the LDO, the 3V3 rail to MCU and SENSOR, the I2C bus between MCU and SENSOR, and the digital switch-in / LED-out lines. Recorded pull-up placement, LED series-R, switch internal pull-up, single-wire SWD, and USB-C CC pulldown choices as defaulted assumptions; no blocking questions.

Architecture: 5 sheets (USB INPUT, LDO 3V3, MCU, SENSOR, USER IO) designed from scratch (no library leaves available). Rails VBUS=5.0, +3V3=3.3, GND. MCU present, I2C comms. Inter-sheet nets: VBUS (USB INPUT->LDO 3V3), +3V3 (LDO 3V3->MCU+SENSOR), GND (all sheets), SDA/SCL bidirectional MCU<->SENSOR, BTN (USER IO->MCU), LED (MCU->USER IO). SWIO kept local to MCU sheet; I2C pull-ups in SENSOR; LED series-R and switch internal pull-up in USER IO.

BOM: 17 parts across USB INPUT/LDO 3V3/MCU/SENSOR/USER IO. ICs: U1 CH32V003J4M6 (vendored ch32v003j4m6), U2 AP2112K-3.3 SOT-23-5 LDO (vendored ap2112k-3v3, C51118 fallback for ME6211), U3 BMP280 (stock Sensor_Pressure:BMP280 + Bosch LGA-8). J1 vendored USB-C with R1/R2 5.1k CC pulldowns and VBUS caps. All passives 0402. ic_groups cluster decoupling/pull-ups with each IC; thermal_ref U2; signal flow J1->U2->U1->U3. NOTE: easyeda2kicad not installed so all three LCSC fetches failed; covered via existing vendored parts + stock KiCad.

Wiring: mapped all pins across 5 sheets. Power: VBUS (J1 VBUS pins A4B9/B4A9 + C1/C2 + LDO VIN/EN), +3V3 (LDO VOUT + MCU VDD + sensor VDD/VDDIO/CSB + I2C pull-ups), GND (USB GND+shield pins, all decoupling, sensor GND/SDO for 0x76 addr, switch, LED cathode). CC1->R1->GND, CC2->R2->GND. I2C: SDA (MCU PC1 + R3 pullup + BMP280 SDI), SCL (MCU PC2 + R4 pullup + BMP280 SCK). USER IO: BTN (MCU PC4 + SW1), LED (MCU PD4 -> R5 -> LED_ANODE -> D1 anode, cathode to GND). No-connects: USB D+/D-/SBU1/SBU2, LDO NC pin4, MCU unused PD6/PA2. CH32V003J4M6 SOP-8 has no dedicated SWIO pin exposed, so no SWIO net.
